adjoint.scope: Crossed module Z9 -> E6_sc, central image Z3, pi1 E6_ad and pi2 Z3, nontrivial Bockstein of universal lifting obstruction. Restriction along H27/Z3 gives xy' extension and nonzero Bockstein. E8_sc has H^3(BE8;Z3)=0, so no analogous ordinary finite one-form Postnikov extension over E8 alone. 27 does not descend to E6_ad as ordinary local representation; higher charged defects or other symmetry structure needed. matter.scope: Infinite Euclidean grid normalized Laplacian 1-average cos(k_i). Convex order of iid sample means decreases with rank (leave-one-out Jensen), so expectation of concave log(m+lambda) increases with rank. For eps<delta log((eps+lambda)/(delta+lambda)) is concave too, so fixed-mass determinant ratio favors maximum rank in bulk. Supplied normalized total hopping rate and flat grid; not arbitrary matter or finite-volume dimension measure.
